description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410001 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 88, 300, 60, and 141) in Lunuwila, including details about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land settlement and title registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
